Gossip protocol state, message handling, and peer tracking logic.

# Purpose
This C file implements the main gossip engine for a network node. It creates and manages the `fd_gossip_t` state, which ties together CRDS storage, an active peer set, a ping tracker, stake data, and push state for outgoing messages. The file also defines the memory layout and initialization logic through [`fd_gossip_footprint`](<#fd_gossip_footprint>), [`fd_gossip_align`](<#fd_gossip_align>), [`fd_gossip_new`](<#fd_gossip_new>), and [`fd_gossip_join`](<#fd_gossip_join>), and it exposes metrics accessors for gossip, CRDS, and ping tracking.

The code handles both transmit and receive paths for gossip traffic. It builds and sends `PING`, `PONG`, `PULL_REQUEST`, `PULL_RESPONSE`, `PUSH`, and `PRUNE` messages, signs contact info and ping payloads, and updates metrics for message and CRDS activity. On receive, it validates incoming CRDS values, inserts accepted data into CRDS, updates peer liveness through the ping tracker, and refreshes the active push set. The file also manages stake updates, contact info refresh, active set rotation, and periodic advancement through [`fd_gossip_advance`](<#fd_gossip_advance>), so it acts as the central control file for gossip protocol state and message flow.
